architecture: 8-node graph memory; learned shared single-query cross-attention and ReLU FFN, d32/h64, no MoE or positional encoding; NOT a language-model experiment
base: 1200 AdamW updates at 2 loops, true two-hop graph labels, lr0.003, batch64, 4096 train graphs
teacher: Same frozen base extended to 4 or8 loops; per-loop FFN up/down rank4 LoRA, 600 updates lr0.006, batch64. Evaluate both two-hop retention and four-hop advancement.
student_training: 600 updates lr0.006, batch64, temperature2 KL to actual trained teacher outputs, same frozen shared base; no teacher adapter weights copied. DEV KL selection every100 steps including step0.
data: 3072 adapter-fit graphs,768 DEV; graph mappings disjoint across splits; after ALL model hashes sealed, generate1536 Fresh and1024 permutation-graph OOD. Five seeds are not five independent task families.
teacher_relevance_gate: At least4/5 primary pairs: DEV accuracy>=0.80 and DEV CE improvement over zero adapters>=0.05nat; otherwise UNCERTAIN. Never drop ineligible seeds.
mirror_replacement_gate: At least4/5 eligible primary pairs: retain>=80% of teacher task-CE benefit over raw, Fresh accuracy loss<=2 percentage points, full inference bytes<=75% of teacher. Benefit=(CEraw-CEstudent)/(CEraw-CEteacher), defined only if denominator>=0.05; no clipping.
mirror_specific_gate: At least4/5 primary seed pairs Mirror2 teacher-output KL>=10% lower than BOTH same-code FiLM and enclosing coupled2. A secondary hybrid result does not replace this gate.
secondary: Other depth/horizon cells; hybrid versus rank1/rank2; local FFN teacher-state errors; gauge-invariant BA singular values; loop code ordering; independently reported OOD. No universal superiority claims.
accounting: 185 final model artifacts=165 trained+20 raw ablations. Actual full and adapter-only inference packets measured separately; all shared base weights paid. Identical updates are NOT equal FLOPs. Isolated CPU timing after workers complete.
environment: Intel Xeon Platinum8573C observed2300MHz, unlocked; Python3.13.5,PyTorch2.10.0+cpu,FP32;4 workers x1 numerical thread
limitations: One tiny graph task family,5 seeds,post-training adapter distillation not joint coadaptation,CPU eager only. No original RRT paper replication, no natural-language performance claim. Historical MA results and main unchanged.
